bleed.name: bleed
bleed.desc:
Open wounds weep with every heartbeat.

Each wound bleeds on its own for a few turns. Armour does nothing to stem it.

Wounds: %1$d
Damage per turn: %2$d
Turns until the last wound closes: %3$d

burn.desc:
Flame clings to flesh and cloth alike.

Burning deals fire damage every turn. A fresh flame renews it rather than adding to it; water puts it out, and it may set dry ground alight.

Turns of burning remaining: %s.

chill.desc:
A deep cold slows every movement.

A chilled character takes 30% longer for every action. Being chilled three times within a few turns freezes it solid for a turn.

Turns of chill remaining: %s.
chill.countDesc:
Frost gathers on this character.

Chill applications so far: %1$d of %2$d. Reaching %2$d within %3$d turns freezes it for a turn.
chill.freezeDesc:
Encased in ice.

A frozen character loses its next action. Any damage shatters the ice at once.

Turns of freeze remaining: %s.

shock.name: shock
shock.desc:
Stray charge crackles beneath the skin, leaving the body raw to every blow.

Shocks: %1$d
Extra damage taken: %2$d%%
Turns remaining: %3$s

blight.name: blight
blight.desc:
A creeping rot spreads through the blood.

Each dose of blight deals damage every turn, and while any remains all healing received is halved.

Doses: %1$d
Damage per turn: %2$d
Turns until the last dose fades: %3$d

stun.desc:
Senses reel and limbs refuse to answer.

A stunned character loses its next action.

Turns remaining: %s.

fear.desc:
Blind panic drives this character away from what it fears.

Only a single blow worth more than a fifth of its Life shocks it out of the terror.

Turns of fear remaining: %s.

slow.desc:
Time drags thick around this character.

A slowed character takes half again as long for every action.

Turns of slow remaining: %s.

weaken.desc:
A sapping weariness settles into the limbs.

A weakened character deals a quarter less damage with every attack, spell and lingering wound it causes.

Turns of weakness remaining: %s.

vulnerable.desc:
Every defence feels paper-thin.

A vulnerable character takes a fifth more damage from every source.

Turns of vulnerability remaining: %s.

blind.desc:
The world dissolves into a dark haze.

A blinded character sees only the tiles beside it, and its attacks find their mark half as often.

Turns of blindness remaining: %s.

ccImmunity.name: unbowed
ccImmunity.desc:
This foe has just shaken off a stun, freeze, fear or root, and will not be held again so soon.

Turns remaining: %s.

healOverTime.name: mending
healOverTime.desc:
Wounds knit slowly closed.

Life restored per turn: %1$d
Turns remaining: %2$d

taunted.name: taunted
taunted.desc:
Goaded beyond reason, this foe can only attack the one who provoked it.

Turns remaining: %s.
